_comment: Online retailers + local Jacksonville, FL pickup spots. Edit freely. 'online' entries are websites to camp for box drops; 'local' entries are in-store pickup around Jacksonville.

online.name: Pokémon Center (official)
online.notes: Best source for Elite Trainer Boxes and exclusive collections.

online.name: Target
online.notes: Online drops + in-store. Watch for 'ship to store' / pickup options.

online.notes: Booster bundles and collection boxes; sells out fast.

online.name: Walmart
online.notes: Frequent online restocks, often late night ET.

local.name: Walmart Supercenter — Jacksonville
local.address: Multiple locations (e.g. Normandy Blvd, Atlantic Blvd)
local.notes: Electronics counter often holds cards behind glass — ask staff.

local.notes: Carries ETBs and collection boxes; call ahead for stock.
